usage: Reference is for style only; outputs contain decorations without a character.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent back-layer game decoration for a child's princess dress-up game. Create a SINGLE portrait 4:5 canvas, intended final size 640x800. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match its charming polished 3D storybook/toy illustration, soft rounded forms, gentle glossy highlights and soft pastel colors. DO NOT DRAW the girl or any character, skin, hair, dress, clothing, hands, shoes, crown, text, numbers, labels or watermark. Draw decoration ONLY on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background with genuine alpha, no solid background, no checkerboard baked in. The invisible doll will stand centered with the top of her head at y=2% and feet at y=98%, occupying roughly x=20%-80%. Keep the central face/chest/torso column x=30%-70%, y=2%-89% visually empty and transparent; decorate primarily the side margins, above and around the head and under the feet. Whole composition contained with a little margin, no clipped edges. Any glow must fade to complete transparency, not cover the canvas with haze. Clean reusable game sprite with readable details at small scale.
Stage 2, little princess: a delicate blush-pink luminous oval halo framing the empty silhouette, very light pearl pink glow only near the OUTER sides, five or six small white-and-rose sparkles loosely scattered along the sides and near the feet. Restrained and simple; no complex rings, no rainbow, no wings. A soft tiny pink crescent of light under the feet. Lots of transparent space in the middle.
